newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks firmer in London trading.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks firmer in London trading.

text.p: Japanese stocks were slightly firmer in London on Tuesday, with interest confined to selected stocks, traders said.

Traders said the market was busier than it has been for a few weeks, with buying pressure and profit-taking on some stocks and interest in property sector shares ahead of tomorrow's Oriental Land auction.

By 1530 GMT London's Nikkei ISE 50 index was up 9.51 points at 1,488.76. In Tokyo the key Nikkei-225 index closed up 124.68 points at 21,418.25, driven by a surging New York stock market and led by gains in blue-chip issues.
"It's quite a busy day for a change," said one trader. "It is a mixed market, with quite a bit of profit taking in stocks that have been moving recently."
The main point of interest was provided by Eisai shares. FDA approval for a new Alzheimers drug after the Tokyo close pushed the shares up 50 yen to 2230 yen by 1530 GMT.
Honda shares were down at 3,290 yen by 1530 GMT after closing in Tokyo at 3,300 yen. NEC shares traded at 1,400 yen, down on their Tokyo close of 1,420 yen.
